CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select private.is_member() and exists(select 1 from private.app_admins a where a.owner_id=(select auth.uid()));
$function$
functions.review_verdict: Private member/admin function checked for authorization, stale state and side effects

functions.complete_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_member()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM private.beta_members m
    WHERE m.owner_id=(SELECT auth.uid())
      AND m.enabled
      AND m.admitted_at IS NOT NULL
  );
$function$
functions.review_verdict: Private member/admin function checked for authorization, stale state and side effects

functions.complete_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.require_member()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid:=auth.uid();
begin
 if u is null or not private.is_member() then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='An admitted beta account is required.'; end if;
 return u;
end $function$
